rules.content:
title: Agent Intent Manipulation — Purchase Divergence from User Intent
status: experimental
description: Detects transactions initiated by AI agents where the product or service purchased diverges significantly from the user's stated intent or historical purchasing patterns, or where the receiving mercha
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: agent_transactions
detection:
    selection:
        initiated_by: "ai_agent"
    condition_category_mismatch:
        category_in_user_history: false
    condition_amount_anomaly:
        amount_exceeds_3x_user_avg: true
    condition_new_merchant:
        merchant_age_days|lte: 30
    condition_high_risk_merchant:
        merchant_risk_score|gte: 0.7
    condition: selection and (1 of condition_*)
level: high
rules.title: DL-0085: Agent Intent Manipulation — Purchase Divergence from User Intent (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Agent Transaction Velocity Anomaly
status: experimental
description: Detects AI agent-initiated transactions at velocities exceeding human purchasing patterns, including multiple purchases per minute and simultaneous multi-merchant purchases within a single agent sessi
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: agent_transactions
detection:
    selection:
        initiated_by: "ai_agent"
    aggregation_velocity:
        count|gte: 5
        groupby: "agent_session_id"
        timeframe: "1m"
    aggregation_multi_merchant:
        dc(merchant_id)|gte: 3
        groupby: "agent_session_id"
        timeframe: "1m"
    condition: selection and (aggregation_velocity or aggregation_multi_merchant)
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0086: Agent Transaction Velocity Anomaly (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: UCP Cart Mandate Gift Card Injection via Indirect Prompt Injection
status: experimental
description: Detects unauthorized gift card line items appended to UCP Cart Mandate payloads by AI shopping agents whose context has been compromised via indirect prompt injection. Threat actors create deals aggre
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: ucp_checkout
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "cart_mandate_submission"
        initiated_by: "ai_agent"
    condition_hidden_gift_card:
        line_item_type|contains:
            - "gift_card"
            - "e_gift_card"
            - "digital_gift_card"
        display_status: "hidden"
    condition_external_recipient:
        line_item_type|contains:
            - "gift_card"
            - "e_gift_card"
            - "digital_gift_card"
        recipient_email_matches_user: false
    condition_agent_added:
        line_item_type|contains:
            - "gift_card"
            - "e_gift_card"
            - "digital_gift_card"
        line_item_added_by: "agent_auto"
        user_intent_contains_gift_card: false
    condition: selection and (1 of condition_*)
level: critical
rules.title: DL-0124: UCP Cart Mandate Gift Card Injection via Indirect Prompt Injection (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: UCP Returns Logic Hijacking — Void Return and Verify Step Bypass
status: experimental
description: Detects exploitation of the UCP returns state machine where AI agents skip the order.return.verify step and trigger settlement.refund.instant() using fraudulent tracking IDs (e.g., void-000). Threat a
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: ucp_returns
detection:
    selection_void_tracking:
        return_tracking_id|startswith: "void-"
    selection_verify_skip:
        return_verify_step_completed: false
        refund_method: "settlement.refund.instant"
    selection_no_shipping_scan:
        shipping_scan_validated: false
        refund_issued: true
    aggregation_velocity:
        count|gte: 10
        groupby: "merchant_id"
        timeframe: "1h"
    condition: selection_void_tracking or selection_verify_skip or (selection_no_shipping_scan and aggregation_velocity)
level: critical
rules.title: DL-0125: UCP Returns Logic Hijacking — Void Return and Verify Step Bypass (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Indirect Prompt Injection in UCP Agent Browsing Content
status: experimental
description: Detects indicators of indirect prompt injection payloads in web content encountered by UCP shopping agents during autonomous browsing. Because UCP agents are designed to autonomously browse, summarize
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: agent_content_scanner
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "agent_content_ingestion"
    condition_hidden_cart_mandate:
        content_contains_hidden_text: true
        hidden_text_pattern|re: "(?i)(\\$?CartMandate|cart_mandate|line.?item|recipient.?email|display.?status.*hidden)"
    condition_refund_injection:
        content_contains_hidden_text: true
        hidden_text_pattern|re: "(?i)(settlement\\.refund|order\\.return\\.verify|refund\\.instant|void-\\d+|skip.*verify)"
    condition_invisible_elements:
        invisible_span_detected: true
        invisible_content_length|gt: 50
        invisible_content_contains_instructions: true
    condition_metadata_injection:
        metadata_contains_instructions: true
        metadata_instruction_pattern|re: "(?i)(system:|action:|observation:)"
    condition: selection and (1 of condition_*)
level: critical
rules.title: DL-0126: Indirect Prompt Injection in UCP Agent Browsing Content (Sigma)
